message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME records for **sample.com** and obtain their IDs, call the VirusTotal DNS‑records endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/dns_records?type=CNAME
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

The JSON response will contain an array of DNS record objects; each object has an `"id"` field. Those `"id"` values are the related object IDs you’re looking for.
